title: Shell an edamame pod into a serving bowl
instruction: Open the edamame pod, put all three beans in the serving bowl, and discard the empty pod in the food-scraps bin.
context: A real-size household food preparation task combining bimanual pod opening, extraction, and waste sorting.
setup: An intact, unopened three-bean pod rests at the center of a 185 mm ceramic plate, long axis along X and stem toward −X. A 156 mm ceramic serving bowl and a 165 mm square open scraps caddy stand nearby. The physical reference is plain Seapoint Farms frozen Edamame in Pods, 14 oz (397 g). Cook directly from frozen in plain boiling water for 5 minutes after the boil returns. Drain and cool. Use a 20–25°C pod within the proposed 60–72 × 14–20 × 10–16 mm range. See README for equivalent products, measurement and lot screening.
reset_notes: Use a new qualifying pod for each trial. Keep unused prepared pods covered at 4°C or below and use the batch within 8 hours. Stage only the selected specimen and start within 30 minutes of cold-storage removal and 10 minutes of its temperature check. Empty, clean, dry and reposition the vessels, dry the work area, and restore both YAM arms to ready with open jaws. Use clean, dry, dedicated stock-equivalent pads with no contact-face overlays. Log prep and trial times, pod size, temperature, condition and pad inspection. Discard robot-handled pods.
scoring: Require intact containment at reset and actual handling of both halves. Score 0.25 for all three seam bonds released and opening above 35°, 0.50 for one extracted bean fully inside the bowl, 0.70 for two, and 0.85 for all three. Full credit requires all shell sections inside the bin and one second of stable retention with hands clear. A bean or shell section lost off the tabletop invalidates the trial.
fidelity: Continuous concave shell with segmented flex, a distributed cohesive seam, and three colliding rigid beans. The simulated pod is 66 × 17 × 14 mm and the simulated beans are about 9–10 mm across. Material properties and seam strength are development estimates. The physical size tolerances, commercial-lot fit and pad-care protocol have not been validated in a hardware trial.
scores: Scripted expert: 1.00 at seed 0. Fresh repeat scores: 1.00 at seeds 0, 1 and 2. All expert trials completed in 1,502 actions. Independent Dream-1: 0.00 at seed 0 over 2,000 actions.
